title: Hold the Keep Gate
summary: Osric Hale, Warden-Captain at Thornwick's well, once held a gate at Greyholt for nine days. If your company can hold Wickham Keep, he'll teach your fighters to stand behind a shield (the fighter's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Hold eight waves in Wickham Keep, north of the crossroads. Any rooms will do.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well.
done: Osric taught your fighters Shield Wall: plant your feet, lift the shield, and let them come to you.
